answer: A Hardware security key bound by challenge-response signature with one identity per channel ties the identity to something the applicant actually controls: the hardware security key answers a fresh challenge, the challenge-response signature is recorded, and one identity per channel keeps one channel from spawning many identities, so a Sybil farm would need a separate real channel for every fake account. A lone juniper cannot fake a channel; only the bound record counts. When the tundra settles over the meadow, the binding holds because every channel answered its own challenge.
